description: Record what a competitor's public profile shows: follower count and their recent posts (date, type, caption, length, and the public views, likes and comments). Use only numbers anyone can see. Never like, follow, comment on or message their account. About 12 to 30 recent posts makes a fair comparison. Matched on platform_post_id; numbers you leave out keep their current values. The numbers first seen at about 1, 3, 7 and 30 days old are kept beside the latest ones. A post with an impossible number (a future date, a count past any post's) is left out and the rest are recorded; warnings says which, and why.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

platform_post_id.description: The network's id for the post (from its link), or the link itself

thumbnail_url.description: The post's picture (https), shown on the Competitors page

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: competitor_posts_record
title: Record a competitor's public posts
